concepts.quote: The square uses 0.5 as the centre
concepts.why: Correctly applies the rule that square(x, y, r) is centred on (x, y) to this code's value (0.5, 0.5), though it says nothing about the side length 2r = 0.5.
The answer says nothing about the double type or its arithmetic.

concepts.quote: the point uses pixels, so both are in the middle
concepts.why: Uses the listed wrong rule that StdDraw.point(256, 256) is in the middle of the default window; in the default unit square (256, 256) lies off the canvas and nothing visible is drawn.
Reads the coordinates as screen pixels; StdDraw's default scale is the unit square and no setXscale/setYscale was called, so (256, 256) is outside the visible range.
